### New Integrations


- [CoGo ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/cogo-eld)
- [EquipmentShare](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/equipmentshare)
- [Spireon FleetLocate Transportation](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/spireon-fleet-locate-transportation)
- [Level ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/level-eld)


### Integration Updates


- [Track Your Truck](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/track-your-truck) now supports[Trips](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/trip) ,[HOS Logs](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/hos-log) , and[Vehicle Utilization](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/vehicle-utilization-day)
- [Track Your Truck](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/track-your-truck) now supports` engine_oil_temperature` in[Vehicle Stat Logs](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/vehicle-stat-log)
- [Geotab](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/geotab) now improves[Vehicle Utilization](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/vehicle-utilization-day) fuel reporting accuracy
- [Geotab](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/geotab) now improves[Camera Media](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/camera-media) retrieval coverage for supported safety events
- [PeopleNet](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/people-net) now supports passthrough API requests


### Dashboard Updates


- The[Terminal Dashboard](https://dashboard.withterminal.com/) now shows elapsed durations in connection sync history
- The[Terminal Dashboard](https://dashboard.withterminal.com/) now supports Motive OAuth scope sync and mismatch visibility in provider settings


### Documentation Updates


- Updated[Samsara configuration documentation](https://docs.withterminal.com/guides/samsara-oauth-configuration) with marketplace publishing and certification guidance
